description: YouTube channels matching a search query (first page, about 20): channel id, name, handle, subscriber count text, description snippet and channel link, from YouTube's public channel-filtered search page. No video lists or exact subscriber counts. Usually answers in about 9 s, up to 28 s on slower calls; allow a 45 s timeout. Related tools on this server, for a different need: social_youtube_channel_email when you need YouTube channel About page from YouTube's public page data; social_youtube_edu_channels when you need education channels on YouTube: channels found by a topic. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: social_youtube_channel_search
title: YouTube channels matching a search query: channel id, name
